summary: Iteration 6 tested Reward Points, ticket credit, the Members Perks Wallet and the camera QR check-in. Backend: the new test file test_nocturne_rewards.py passed 11/11. The full regression suite (-n 0, ai_draft skipped) passed 83/83. Frontend (375x667): profile rewards/perks cards, /rewards redeem flow, /perks claim and unlock, the event-detail Reward credit row and points hint, a UI ticket purchase with credit applied ($92 -> $87), and the /checkin camera pre-prompt, Not now, Allow and manual check-in all worked with no page errors. No functional bugs found. Deprecated packages detected: none (uses expo-camera, no expo-av or expo-barcode-scanner).

minor.issue: Credit is taken from the user before the ticket insert. If tickets.insert_one fails, the credit is lost and nothing gives it back. Same for the redeem ledger insert after the $inc (rewards.py:49-54). Low risk, but these steps are not one transaction.
Luxe points use the guest's level when the admin confirms, not when the guest booked. A guest who upgrades or downgrades in between gets a different multiplier. Check this is intended.
Points are never reversed. There is no cancel or refund path today, but there is also no hook to take back points or credit if one is added.

ui_bugs.issue: After the user already holds a ticket, the event page still shows 'Buy ticket · $92.00'. Tapping it gets a 400 'already on guest list' from the backend. Existed before this round.

issues: checkin-close is 40x40, below the 44pt touch target (checkin.tsx:176-179). The rewards and perks back buttons are 44.

action_items: Optional: add a guard to hide or disable buy-ticket-btn when the user already holds a ticket for the event.
Optional: give back credit_used if the ticket insert fails after the credit is taken in issue_ticket.
critical_code_review_comments: Redeem is atomic: update_one has a points $gte filter. Credit can't go negative: credit_balance $gte guard plus min(credit, total). Verified by tests.
Ticket points are earned on total_paid, i.e. after credit is applied (correct, verified). The frontend points-hint uses the same formula as the backend.
Perk claim is idempotent: $setOnInsert upsert gives one claim doc. Locked perks return 403. The code only appears after claiming.
Checkin: permission flow handles granted, the pre-prompt and canAskAgain=false (Open Settings). Short ticket codes (#BE87C835, any case) resolve on the backend.

Older regression tests (test_nocturne_api, features, extras, race) buy with the seeded guest and promoter accounts. Their teardown deletes tickets and bookings but not points_ledger, and does not reset users.points. This leaves seeded users with points after every run. test_nocturne_membership.py deleted TEST users but left orphaned ledger rows (fixed in its teardown).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_nocturne_membership.py (teardown also deletes points_ledger and perk_claims of TEST users)
seed_data_creation: Set guest points to 600 temporarily for the UI redeem test. Then reset all seeded users to level bronze, points 0, credit_balance 0, wallet 0. Deleted the UI ticket (tickets_sold decremented), the seeded users' points_ledger rows and perk_claims, and 5 orphaned ledger rows from deleted TEST users. Rooftop Reverie capacity is 2. All events have tickets_sold 0 and 0 TEST users remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 -k 'not ai_draft' (about 3 min). Afterwards run tests/cleanup_iteration6.py (adjust SINCE). It resets seeded users' points and credit, which regression tests inflate. Headless Chromium grants a fake camera, so camera-allow opens camera-view on web. Perks: 9 seeded, 3 bronze, 6 locked for bronze. NOCWELCOME is the bronze welcome-cocktail code. Container clock is about 2026-11-14.
